# pluginsync

<!-- GENERATED by @natjswenson/skillhelp — do not edit. Run `skillhelp build`. -->

- **version** — 0.1.0
- **stack** — node
- **summary** — Refresh the locally-installed Claude Code plugin marketplaces so newly released skill versions are actually on disk. Use when the user says "update my marketplace", "refresh my skills", "update the claude-skills plugins", "am I on the latest skills", "install the new skill", or "why is /skillfactory still the old version". Reports installed vs available version per plugin, installs what is missing, updates what drifted, flags plugins shadowed by a stale personal copy in ~/.claude/skills, and always says whether a restart is still needed. `skills/pluginsync/skills/pluginsync/SKILL.md:3`
- **triggers** — "am I on the latest skills", "install the new skill", "refresh my skills", "update my marketplace", "update the claude-skills plugins", "why is /skillfactory still the old version"

## Setup

- **Claude Code:** Install the claude CLI; the bundled Node reconciler reads and updates Claude marketplaces. `skills/pluginsync/README.md:84`
- **Codex:** Install the codex CLI and use its plugin commands; the bundled Node reconciler manages Claude installations only. Claude app connections are not imported. `skills/pluginsync/README.md:85`
- **Personal data:** Claude state remains under ~/.claude/plugins/ and personal skills under ~/.claude/skills/; Codex manages its own plugin state. Neither route migrates personal data. `skills/pluginsync/README.md:86`
- See [Codex migration notes](../../docs/codex-migration.md) for host tools and retained data paths. `skills/pluginsync/README.md:88`
- Node 18+ (the bundled scripts are ESM, no dependencies). `skills/pluginsync/README.md:90`
- Requires Node >=18 (package.json engines). `skills/pluginsync/skills/pluginsync/package.json:33`

## Architecture

- Deterministic: resolve every marketplace's install location and each plugin's available version from plugin.json on disk — node scripts/pluginsync.js check --no-fetch `skills/pluginsync/skills/pluginsync/skill-invariants.json:26`
- Deterministic: diff installed against available and classify each row — node scripts/pluginsync.js check `skills/pluginsync/skills/pluginsync/skill-invariants.json:30`
- Deterministic: install/update each drifted plugin and read the resulting version back off disk — node scripts/pluginsync.js apply `skills/pluginsync/skills/pluginsync/skill-invariants.json:34`
- Model judgment: decide whether an orphan or disabled plugin is deliberate or rot — nothing on disk records intent — a disabled project-scoped plugin is normal, a disabled user-scoped one is usually a… `skills/pluginsync/skills/pluginsync/skill-invariants.json:40`
- Model judgment: decide what to do about a plugin shadowed by a personal copy in ~/.claude/skills — the shadowing directory sometimes holds user data alongside the stale SKILL.md, so deleting the dire… `skills/pluginsync/skills/pluginsync/skill-invariants.json:44`
- Model judgment: explain a stalled row — the CLI exits 0 either way, so why a version did not move is a diagnosis, not a field `skills/pluginsync/skills/pluginsync/skill-invariants.json:48`

## Troubleshooting

- A plugin is not refreshed until the new version is read back — The one rule. It is the reason this skill exists rather than a prompt; lose the line and the skill becomes a generic assistant with extr… `skills/pluginsync/skills/pluginsync/skill-invariants.json:9`
- Never claim a result you did not observe — Honesty about what was verified is the whole house contract. A skill that reports success it did not witness is worse than one that reports nothing. `skills/pluginsync/skills/pluginsync/skill-invariants.json:14`

- **A plugin is not refreshed until the new version is read back off disk, and it is not live until Claude Code restarts — report those as three different states and never collapse them into one.** `skills/pluginsync/skills/pluginsync/SKILL.md:151`
- **Never claim a result you did not observe.** Say what you verified and what you did not. `skills/pluginsync/skills/pluginsync/SKILL.md:152`
- **Never report a stalled row as updated.** The command exiting 0 is not evidence; the version on disk is the only evidence. `skills/pluginsync/skills/pluginsync/SKILL.md:154`
- **Never uninstall an orphan without being asked.** A refresh removes nothing. `skills/pluginsync/skills/pluginsync/SKILL.md:156`
- **An unreadable source is an error row, never a dropped one.** A plugin the tool could not read must never be summarised inside "everything matches". `skills/pluginsync/skills/pluginsync/SKILL.md:157`
